messages:
samir: heads up — we're seeing missing trace hits in Kibana for a subset of requests routed to us-west1 around 09:12 UTC. root trace id: abc123def. looks like a chunk of logs never landed in Loki.
lia: ugh. did anything change in us-west1 at that time? deployments / node reimage?
samir: there was a scheduled reimage for a GPU host in the cluster at 09:10 (auto-reimage after kernel patch). few pods moved. I can see a burst of 5xx from distributor around that window.
matthew: can you paste a Loki query for the missing trace? I'll try cross-region search.
samir: sure — ran this in Loki already but returns nothing for that trace id:```logql
{cluster=\"us-west1\", job=\"ingester\"} |= \"trace_id=abc123def\" | line_format \"{timestamp} {level} {msg}\"
```
nina: ingest-bot logged distributor errors at that time:```text
ingest-bot: 2026-03-18T09:11:58Z distributor: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed by peer
ingest-bot: 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z distributor: failed to write chunk to ingester: context deadline exceeded
```
samir: I also checked S3 object store — chunk index files exist for that time window, but compactor shows some leases timing out. suspect compactor/ingester handshake issues during node shuffle.
lia: Prom alert firing? grafana?
matthew: got these alerts firing around the same time: `LokiDistributorErrors > 5m` and `loki_ingest_submit_failures_total` spike. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/Loki/ingest-overview?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now :eyes:
samir: kubectl logs from distributor pod-2:```bash
kubectl -n logging logs distributor-2 --since=15m | grep \"rpc error\"
# shows repeated Unavailable and EOF during 09:11-09:13
```
lia: so path is: distributor -> ingester -> object store (S3). If ingester couldn't commit chunks, index entries might be missing, hence Kibana can't correlate trace->logs.
matthew: quick repro query to find partial hits by request id (to surface any shards that kept logs):```logql
{cluster=\"us-west1\"} |= \"request_id=xyz789\" | unwrap message
```
samir: only fragments show up from other regions. us-west1 seems to have a gap.
nina: ops-bot captured node lifecycle events: node-112 reimage started 09:09, drain completed 09:10, node came back 09:18. That 8-min window overlaps gaps.
lia: mitigation ideas? reingest from s3? re-run compactor?
matthew: reingest is messy — we'd need the write-ahead metadata. Short-term: enable distributed search fallback to cross-region index (we already have cross-region read enabled but some index meta missing). Also consider temporarily increasing log retention query window and broaden query labels to find unindexed entries.
samir: can we trigger ingester restart + compactor run to try to pick up orphaned chunks? risk: duplicate later but acceptable if we mark as backfill.
nina: compactor restart sequence:```bash
kubectl -n logging rollout restart statefulset/compactor
# monitor compactor logs for \"index uploaded\" messages
```
lia: long-term: we should add a pre-drain hook that waits for ingester flush and confirm chunk index commits before node reimage. maybe a k8s lifecycle hook or drain-runbook step. saves us this lossy window. :thumbsup:
matthew: also think about alert tuning — `LokiDistributorErrors` threshold is noisy on short bursts. Add a 5m aggregate and tie to `ingest_submit_failures_total` so we avoid paging on short reimages.
samir: cost note — re-ingesting or increasing retention for full raw logs will spike S3 and query costs. we need a playbook that balances cost vs completeness (e.g., keep 1d of full-indexed traces, 14d sampled).
nina: I'll open a runbook PR with the restart steps, and add a checklist for reimage safe drain.
samir: thanks — I'll try a compactor restart in staging first and report. if anyone else sees missing traces for other ids pls drop them here.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0318-09 — missing-loki-chunks-us-west1. Assigned to eng-sre oncall.
lia: thanks. tagging paging rotation to avoid wakeups overnight if it's a short reimage noise. :sleeping:
matthew: update: compactor in staging reprocessed 09:40 — index uploads resumed. will schedule a controlled compactor restart in prod during low traffic window.
samir: final: filed cost vs retention RFC in #eng-sre-docs, linking runbook. we'll review on the next oncall handoff. :white_check_mark:
